Its run, frozen definition and FAIL evidence are retained unchanged. Revision 2 requires temporally persistent segment evidence and uses disjoint seeds.
scope: The nine M2-SEG2-* registry fixtures: generator recipe, independent truth, case derivation, split/counts, scoring and unchanged gate. WWAlignSegment and WWAlignSegmentTests are pinned by tree ID. WWAlignEstimate remains frozen and is consumed through its public API.
pinnedTreesRule: SegmentFreezeTests computes both git tree IDs from working-tree bytes, including untracked files; the freeze takes effect on merge. Any subsequent code or fixture change requires another dated revision and a fresh holdout.

segmenter.algorithm: Rev-1 dense tile/least-squares fit, conservative boundary brackets, re-estimation and overlap demotion remain; a fitted segment must additionally span at least minimumSupportedSeconds in eligible window-centre time before it can establish a boundary. Short coherent outlier runs are unresolved islands and cannot manufacture a clock step or slope change. No mapped region crosses a detected jump; unlocalisable frames remain unsupported.
segmenter.outputs: Mapped regions are acousticConsistentProposal only; unresolved, unlocalisable and untrusted regions are typed unsupported with no inverse. Epochs and occurrences are retained. Never clockApproved.

generator.kind: synthetic-deterministic, in test code only; no actual recordings
generator.recipe: Identical to m2-freeze-discontinuity.generator, except disjoint master seeds and increased transient/silenceGap calibration counts. Scene, draws, clock truth, planted size ranges, rate, duration and scoring are unchanged.
generator.seedDerivation: SplitMix64. caseSeed(master, stratum, index) = first output of SplitMix64(seed: master XOR fnv1a64(UTF-8 stratum.rawValue) XOR (index &* 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)); SegmentPlan.make draws from that stream. SegmentFreezeTests asserts no rev-2 calibration, sweep or holdout case seed occurs in any rev-1 split (including the failed holdout).

truth.scoring: Identical to m2-freeze-discontinuity.truth.scoring: independent OccurrenceTruth, never correlation peaks or the fitted map; every planted frame and inserted interval checked for bridging; residuals sampled every second plus each mapped region's last frame, nearest-rank p95 and maximum; inverse, monotonicity, retention and false splits checked by Scoring.swift.
truth.positive strata: dropped (5-500 ms), inserted (5-500 ms), clockStep (+/-5-500 ms), restart (0.3-1.2 s pause plus rate change), rateChange (300-400 ppm), compound (two plants at least 15 s apart).
truth.negative strata: clean, target-only strong transient (4-8 clicks/bursts), scene-silent or muted-target silenceGap (3-8 s); no clock change. Any detection or more than one mapped region is a false split.

split.unit: one in-memory reference and target occurrence per case

holdout.status: NOT RUN. No rev-2 holdout case is rendered or segmented in this PR; disjointness checks derive seeds only.

floorSweep.design: clockStep +/-0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5 ms and rateChange 25, 50, 100, 200, 300 ppm; two repeats each

gate.verbatim: WW-017 (docs/m2/ww-019-m2-contracts.md §5): supported residuals meet WW-016; every planted discontinuity is flagged or unsupported, with zero silent smooth bridging; segments are positive and monotonic; gaps have no inverse; source occurrences and epochs are retained.
gate.evaluator: SegmentRunner.gateFailures over CaseScore.hardFailures, identical to revision 1.
definition: Plants: every planted discontinuity is flagged or unsupported; bridged plants must be 0.

Bridging: no mapped region may contain frames on both sides of a plant or any inserted frame (bridgingRegions 0); a bridging region whose truth residual is inside the WW-016 gate is a silent smooth bridge and must be 0.
Residuals: every mapped region in every case has truth residual nearest-rank p95 <= 5 ms and max <= 10 ms.

Segments positive and monotonic: every mapped segment's rateRatio is > 0, and aligned time from the compiled map strictly increases across all mapped residual-grid frames taken together in frame order. WWTimeMap itself rejects overlapping epoch images (overlappingEpochs) and non-monotonic placement, so the scorer's check is defence in depth behind the map type.

Gaps have no inverse: between consecutive mapped truth pieces whose aligned images leave a gap (dropped samples, positive steps, restarts), 5 aligned instants inside the gap (excluding 2 ms + 1 frame at each side) must not invert to any source frame; on a 0.5 s aligned grid over the truth image, every instant that does invert must land within 10 ms + 1 frame of its truth time and never in an inserted frame.

Retention: the map has exactly one placement, of the identical request occurrence; regions tile the declared span exactly and keep its declared epoch; region epochs are distinct, the declared epoch is present (kept on the first mapped region), and the placement spans equal the regions; no epoch is clockApproved; the report carries the frozen segmenter identifier.
False splits: on clean and near-miss negatives the false-split rate must be <= maximumFalseSplitRate (0).

holdoutProcedure.when: Once in a separate PR after this freeze merges, on a clean commit containing its merge commit; check pinned WWAlignSegment and WWAlignSegmentTests trees and unchanged WWAlignEstimate source.
holdoutProcedure.command: cd Packages/WaveWranglerKit && WW_SEGMENT_HOLDOUT=1 WW_SEGMENT_RECORDS_DIR="$PWD/../../docs/m2/evidence/ww-017" swift test --jobs 4 --no-parallel --scratch-path ../../.build/swiftpm --filter SegmentHoldoutTests
holdoutProcedure.compute: Only heavy job; harness default four cases in flight, override may lower to 1...4.
holdoutProcedure.report: Commit SHA, host, exact source/test/dependency trees, raw per-case log and unedited canonical holdout-2.jsonl with SHA-256, full totals and unchanged gate verdict, whether PASS or FAIL.
holdoutProcedure.rules: Run the full frozen split exactly once; do not rerun, cherry-pick, relabel or lower the gate after a failure. Keep rev-1 FAIL evidence unchanged.

postFreezeRule: Changes to recipe, truth, counts, gate, source or test tree or segmenter parameters require a dated freeze revision and a fresh holdout; previous runs remain recorded.
